Name: Quit Smoking Sebastian - Furry Overhaul Alteration
Author: Lycanglass
Description:
[size=5]UPDATED FOR STARDEW VALLEY 1.5; REPLACER VERSION!

[/size]1.5.0 includes:
- Changed into replacer version
- Beach-ready Sebastians

---

For use with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Furry Overhaul Mod[/url].

After you successfully woo your wolf, he claims to be trying to quit - yet sometimes, you can still catch him smoking (including in the Stardew Valley Fall Festival). To help resolve this issue, and keep Sebastian on track, I made a simple mod that replaces his cigarette with a Miner's Treat - healthier, tastier, and will help him find lost USBs, too! For this to make the most sense in-game, I'd recommend you install this after Sebastian's 10 heart event.

This mod is designed to work with the Content Patcher version of the furry mod. To install, simply drag the files into your mod folder, and agree to the overwrite.

This mod contains both the regular community sprite, as well as my own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2345/]Soft Sebastian[/url] alteration (used in the image), incase you want a plump Seb in your game instead. Choose whichever suits your needs.
